subsystems.name: Space-based transit photometry
subsystems.role: records the dip in starlight during transit at high cadence, catching brief bumps where the planet crosses a spot or facula.

subsystems.name: High-resolution ground spectroscopy
subsystems.role: splits light into fine lines; a planet's lines shift in velocity during transit, whereas stellar lines do not, allowing them to be separated.
parts: wavelength calibration (laser frequency comb or gas cell)

subsystems.name: Stellar activity modelling
subsystems.role: describes how spots, faculae and granulation change the star's spectrum and colour.

subsystems.name: Transmission spectrum reduction pipeline
subsystems.role: turns raw detector counts into a relative spectrum of the planet plus star, removing instrument systematics.

subsystems.name: Joint atmospheric retrieval
subsystems.role: fits the planet atmosphere and stellar contamination in one model, so each is bounded by the other.
parts: prior ranges on stellar and planetary parameters

subsystems.name: Ancillary stellar data
subsystems.role: provides the out-of-transit baseline needed to know what the unocculted star looks like.

buildSteps.title: Characterise the host star first
buildSteps.detail: Take spectra and photometry outside transit to measure temperature, gravity, rotation period and the amplitude of its variability.

buildSteps.title: Observe the transit from space
buildSteps.detail: Record the transit at high cadence in the infrared, looking for wavelength-dependent depth changes and spot-crossing anomalies.

buildSteps.title: Observe the transit from the ground
buildSteps.detail: Take simultaneous high-resolution spectra, tracking the Rossiter-McLaughlin signal and the velocity shift of individual lines.

buildSteps.title: Fit a spot/facula model
buildSteps.detail: Estimate the covering fraction and temperature contrast of active regions on the visible face, using colours and line shapes.

buildSteps.title: Reduce the transmission spectrum
buildSteps.detail: Extract the wavelength-by-wavelength transit depth while fitting out instrument systematics.

buildSteps.title: Insert activity into the retrieval
buildSteps.detail: Run the atmospheric retrieval with extra parameters for unocculted spots, faculae and their spectral signature.

buildSteps.title: Stress-test the claim
buildSteps.detail: Repeat with alternative stellar models and injected false signals, checking whether a molecular detection survives.

buildSteps.title: Report with contamination bounds
buildSteps.detail: Publish the detection together with quantified upper limits on how much of it could be stellar, and archive the data for re-analysis.

prerequisites.tech: Space telescopes with stable infrared spectroscopy
prerequisites.why: the transit signal is tiny; only a space platform avoids the water and oxygen absorption of Earth's atmosphere.
separating planetary lines from stellar lines needs line-shape resolution and sub-metre-per-second stability.

prerequisites.tech: Stellar atmosphere models including active regions
prerequisites.why: spot and facula spectra are less well measured than quiet-star spectra, especially for cool stars.

prerequisites.tech: Bayesian retrieval frameworks that accept stellar terms
prerequisites.why: without them, contamination is either ignored or corrected by hand, which hides the uncertainty.
space and ground telescopes are scheduled separately, so truly simultaneous coverage is hard to arrange.

pathway.milestone: routine spot and activity corrections applied to published transmission spectra from HST and JWST
pathway.unlocks: atmosphere detections that come with an explicit contamination budget rather than a bare claim.

pathway.milestone: joint retrievals with wavelength-dependent stellar contamination as standard practice
pathway.unlocks: comparable results across different teams and instruments.

pathway.milestone: benchmark campaigns on deliberately active host stars
pathway.unlocks: calibrated limits on how much contamination a given model leaves behind.

pathway.milestone: cross-validation between transmission spectroscopy and high-resolution ground detections of the same molecules
pathway.unlocks: biosignature candidates strong enough to survive independent re-analysis.
